sentences.text:
This miscellaneous second appeal is filed under Section 54(2) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894,
seeking to modify the judgment and award passed by the Additional Civil Judge (Sr.Dn), Gulbarga,
in LAC No.147/1995 dated 02.04.1998 and also the judgment and award passed by the III Additional District Judge at Gulbarga, dated 02.08.2004 in LACA No.1/2004, by enhancing the compensation.
2.
The appellant was the owner of the land bearing Survey No.186/2 measuring 2 acre 32 guntas of dry land NC: 2024:KHC-K:2220 situated at Nagur Village, Taluk and District Kalaburagi.
The said land was acquired for construction of Bennetora Project vide notification dated 16.05.1991.
The Special Land Acquisition Officer awarded compensation of Rs.15,000/- per acre vide award dated 24.12.1993.

Upon reference, the reference Court enhanced the compensation amount to Rs.25,000/-
per acre with all statutory benefits.
In appeal, the District Court computed the compensation at Rs.32,000/- per acre.
Now the appellant seeks compensation on the basis of the judgment and award passed by the Co-Ordinate Bench of this Court in MSA No.200014/2018 (LAC) dated 21.02.2018.

3. Learned counsel appearing for respondent No.2 Sri Sanjeevkumar C. Patil and learned High Court Government Pleader Sri Gopalkrishna B. Yadav, appearing for respondent No.1 have not disputed the judgment and award passed by this Court in MSA No.200014/2018 and they fairly submitted that the respondents have not challenged the said judgment and award passed by this NC: 2024:KHC-K:2220 Court.
In that view of the matter, the matter has attained finality.

In the light of the above, the prayer of the appellant seeking enhancement of compensation shall be treated at par with the compensation awarded by this Court in MSA No.200014/2018 dated 21.02.2018 as the land acquired in the present appeal also situate in the same village, and in acquired for the same project and the under the notification issued in the same year.

Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER 1) The appeal is partly allowed with costs.

Appellant is entitled for compensation of Rs.1,64,223/- per acre in respect of land in Sy.No.186/2,
measuring 2 acre 32 guntas, situate at Nagur Village, with all statutory benefits and with cost.
3) It is made clear that as per order passed by this Court on 14.03.2024, appellant is not entitled for interest for the delayed period of 4429 days in filing the appeal.
4) Eight weeks' time is granted to make good the Deficit Court Fee.
